prayerTree.title: Haftalik ibodat daraxti
prayerTree.subtitle: Bu hafta yakunlandi: {{count}}/35 Namozlar
prayerTree.quote: Namoz iymon ustunidir; Har bir tugallangan ibodat daraxtingiz uchun gullab-yashnayotgan yashil bargni oladi.
prayerTree.quoteHigh: “Namoz iymon ustunidir”. — Ajoyib hafta o'tkazyapsiz, MashaAlloh!
prayerTree.quoteMid: “Namozni to‘kis ado eting, zakot bering va ruku qiluvchilar bilan birga ruku qiling”. (Baqara, 43).
prayerTree.quoteLow: “Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times.” (An-Niso, 103).
